LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_RavenLiquidHotSpring.label: [Raven] Fluid Hot Spring
LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_RavenLiquidHotSpring.descr: A raven fluid hot spring with a slowly flowing milky surface. It can be laid out in any shape, blends naturally into surrounding terrain, and can be decorated around the edges as desired.
